rejection.PRIVACY: Photo shows people or personal data

blocked.REPUTATION_TOO_LOW: Your reputation is below the minimum to accept tasks. A moderator will review your account.
blocked.ACCOUNT_NOT_VERIFIED: Confirm your email to accept tasks. The link is in your inbox.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.lead: Pick a task, go to the stall and send what you saw. Each approved submission earns the commission shown.
tasks.locationDenied: No access to your location. The list stays in priority order.
tasks.emptyBody: Turn on notifications to know when a task opens at your markets.
tasks.offline: No connection. Tasks appear when the signal returns; your queued submissions stay saved.
tasks.pushOffer: Get a notice when a task opens at your markets.
tasks.pushIos: On iPhone, notices work after you add the app to the home screen.
tasks.pushDenied: Notifications are blocked in the browser settings.
tasks.pushDisabled: Notifications are not available on this server.
tasks.pushError: We couldn't turn on notifications right now.
tasks.mapLabel: Map of markets with open tasks

summary.deadlines: After accepting: 2 hours to check in at the market and 1 hour to send.

accept.body: The task is reserved for you. If you can't go, give it up: it returns to the list with no penalty.
accept.done: Task accepted. The check-in clock is running.
accept.failed: We couldn't accept it. Someone else may have accepted first.

checkIn.body: When you are at {{market}}, tap the button. You need to be within {{radius}} m of the market centre.
checkIn.done: Checked in. You now have 1 hour to send.
checkIn.doneLow: Checked in with imprecise GPS. You can continue; moderation will check.
checkIn.outOfRange: You are {{km}} km from the market. Get closer and try again.
checkIn.denied: The browser blocked location. Allow access in the site settings and try again.
checkIn.timeout: The GPS took too long to answer. Move to a more open spot and try again.
checkIn.unavailable: We couldn't get the location on this device.
checkIn.failed: We couldn't check in right now.
checkIn.help: Location only confirms that you are at the market; it is not stored on the device.

release.afterCheckIn: Give up (the task returns to the list)
release.done: You gave it up. The task is back on the list.
release.failed: We couldn't do that right now.
release.confirmBody: It goes back to the list and someone else can take it.
release.confirmBodyAfter: After check-in, giving up counts as an expired task in your reputation.

form.codeHint: As written on the stall sign, for example 142 or A-07.
form.vendorNameHint: Optional. Only shown if the vendor agrees below.
form.notesHint: Optional. Anything that helps check the submission.

consent.title: Vendor's consent
consent.body: Ask the vendor whether they agree to the stall appearing on NANDESK. Without a "yes", the stall can't be registered.
consent.publish: The vendor agrees to the stall appearing in the app.
consent.showName: The vendor agrees to show their name.

verify.title: What did you find?
verify.body: Check at the stall whether the reported problem is real.

offerings.currentHint: For each product: confirm it is unchanged, change the price or remove it if it's gone.
offerings.removeRow: Remove this product from the submission

photo.title: Photos
photo.hint: 1 to 5 photos. Shoot the stall sign and the products; avoid faces and documents.
photo.hintNew: 1 to 5 photos, at least one of the stall front. Avoid faces and documents.
photo.label: Photo {{n}}
photo.unreadable: We couldn't read this image. Take the photo again.

state.failed: Photo not accepted: take it again

errors.title: Almost there. Check:
errors.stallPhotoRequired: Include a photo of the stall front.
errors.consentRequired: Tick the vendor's consent for the stall to appear.
errors.verificationRequired: Say whether the reported problem is real.
errors.priceInvalid: Write the price with numbers only, for example 12.50.
errors.productRequired: Pick the product or write the suggested name.
errors.productDuplicated: Each product can appear only once.

submit.hint: No signal? The submission waits in the device queue and goes out on its own when the connection returns.
submit.sending: Sending. You can close the app: it keeps going.
submit.queued: No signal right now. The submission is queued and will go out when the connection returns.
submit.queuedHint: You can close the app: it will send by itself when the signal returns.

submitted.received: Received. Moderation will review it now.

outbox.RETRY_WAIT: Waiting for signal to try again

needsAction.RESERVATION_EXPIRED: The task deadline passed before the submission arrived. It returned to the list.
needsAction.TASK_NOT_AVAILABLE: This task is no longer available.
needsAction.CHECKIN_REQUIRED: Check in at the market before sending.
needsAction.INVALID_PHOTO: One of the photos was not accepted. Take it again.
needsAction.VALIDATION_ERROR: Some data was not accepted. Check it and send again.
needsAction.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED: This submission was already received with different content.
needsAction.FORBIDDEN: Your account can't submit this task.
needsAction.OTHER: The submission was not accepted. Check the task.

history.title: History
history.lead: Your tasks, from acceptance to the moderation result.
history.emptyBody: When you accept a task, it shows up here with the result.

earnings.title: Earnings
earnings.lead: Commissions credited per approved submission. The team pays out by PIX, outside the app.
earnings.pixMissing: Register a PIX key to get paid.
earnings.emptyBody: Each approved submission creates a credit here.

reputation.title: Reputation
reputation.body: Based on your last {{window}} tasks. Below {{minimum}}, new tasks are blocked until a review.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.emptyBody: Notices about tasks, deadlines and results show up here.
